intro.title: Learn it: make 10 on a ten-frame!
intro.say: Let’s make ten on a ten-frame. Two numbers fill the frame together. Tap Start.

bond: {name} has {a} shields. How many more make {t}?
The castle has {t} flags. {a} flags are up. How many more go up?
{a} knights sit at the table. There are {t} chairs. How many chairs are empty?
The king wants {t} tarts. The cook has made {a}. How many more?
{name} needs {t} bricks for a tower. {name} has {a}. How many more?
take: {name} has {a} apples. A horse eats {b}. How many apples are left?
{a} knights stand on the wall. {b} go inside. How many are left?
{name} bakes {a} tarts. The dragon eats {b}. How many tarts are left?
There are {a} torches. {b} blow out. How many are still lit?
{name} has {a} gold coins. {name} gives {b} to the queen. How many coins are left?
